clue.text: Be on salary that's been adjusted in a fair manner

indicators.note: something adjusted has been altered, so the letters of the preceding words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone's pay has been revised so that it is now fair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's been adjusted' rearranges the ten letters of BE ON SALARY.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: acting reasonably means behaving fairly and sensibly.

clue.text: Regretted being trapped by true dilemma

indicators.note: being trapped by says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Someone sorry to be caught in a genuine quandary.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to rue something is to regret it.

clue.text: Distressed genius had to be sorted out

indicators.note: sorting out reorganises things, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A troubled genius who needed fixing.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: anguished describes someone in deep distress.

clue.text: Gold, fashion for sixties playwright

parts.note: or is gold in heraldry
ton is an old word for fashion or style

explanation.surface: Gold and style suiting a dramatist of the 1960s.
explanation.definitionFit: Joe Orton wrote black comedies such as Loot and Entertaining Mr Sloane in the 1960s.

clue.text: A revolutionary king on a river with a ferryman

parts.note: Che Guevara, the Marxist revolutionary
R is short for rex, king

explanation.surface: A revolving monarch adrift on a river with a boatman.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Charon ferries the dead across this river of the underworld.

clue.text: Policy has NI party in a row

parts.note: a party line is a policy
the DUP is the Democratic Unionist Party of Northern Ireland

explanation.surface: A Northern Irish party's policy is in dispute.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a row' suggests a quarrel; it means arranged in a line.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: things lined up stand in a straight row.

clue.text: Old thing with pointed end to get fish

definitions.meaning: a long spear once carried by infantry

explanation.surface: An antique sharp implement used to catch a fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: the old infantry weapon with a spearhead, and the freshwater predator fish.

clue.text: Hotel is just ahead of me!

definitions.text: Hotel is just ahead of me!

parts.words: Hotel is just ahead of me!
parts.note: in the NATO phonetic alphabet the code word for H comes immediately before the one for I

explanation.walkthrough: The speaker is a code word in the phonetic alphabet: Golf, Hotel, then the speaker for I.
explanation.definitionFit: Alphabet code: in radio spelling Hotel stands for H and this word stands for I, the next letter.

clue.text: Thrill created by old lover, a real hit when reunited

parts.note: an ex is a former partner

indicators.note: pieces reunited are put back together in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A former partner gets excited when a big hit is reunited.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to thrill someone is to make them elated.

clue.text: Cube's dimension, but not its abbreviated form

definitions.text: Cube's dimension, but not its abbreviated form

indicators.note: but not says something is excluded from what precedes

parts.note: height is one of the measurements of a cube
h is the standard abbreviation for height

explanation.surface: A puzzle about measuring a cube without using a shorthand label.
explanation.walkthrough: Taking H, the abbreviation for height, away from HEIGHT leaves the answer; and two cubed is this number, while a cube also has this many corners.
explanation.definitionFit: Two cubed equals this number, and a cube has this many vertices, so the whole clue also points to it.

clue.text: The last sheep back in the fold?

definitions.text: The last sheep back in the fold?

parts.words: The last sheep back in the fold?
parts.note: in the parable a shepherd leaves ninety-nine sheep to seek the one that strayed; when it returns it completes the count of a hundred

explanation.walkthrough: The parable of the lost sheep: ninety-nine stay safe and one wanders; the final one home is the one that completes a hundred.
explanation.definitionFit: Ordinal number: the returning lost sheep is number one hundred in the count.

clue.text: It could mean 'left off'? Absolutely correct!

definitions.meaning: take the opposite of each word: left becomes right, off becomes on

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: each word of 'left off' swapped for its opposite, and a slangy cry of emphatic approval.

clue.text: Cast aside is retreating US soldier, not a revolutionary

indicators.note: retreating means going backwards, so the soldier's letters are read in reverse

parts.note: GI is the usual term for an American soldier
'no' as in 'no man' means not a single one
a red is a communist revolutionary

explanation.surface: An American soldier who has fallen back is dismissed as no rebel.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to cast something aside is to disregard or pay it no attention.

clue.text: Good artist, the Italian revealing holy object?

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
il is Italian for the

explanation.surface: A fine painter and an Italian unveiling a sacred relic.
explanation.definitionFit: The Holy Grail is the sacred cup of Arthurian legend; the question mark flags the punning 'holy'.

clue.text: This writer's demonstrated — is being locked up, knocked up

parts.note: the setter speaking: this writer is = I'm

indicators.note: locked up means imprisoned, so the word is goes inside

parts.note: to demonstrate something is to prove it

explanation.surface: A writer claims proof of being jailed and made pregnant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knocked up' looks like slang for pregnant, but here it means made hastily.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: to knock something up is to make it hastily, improvising from what is to hand.

clue.text: Hairy style of new champion exuding power

indicators.note: new says the letters are made into a fresh arrangement
exuding means letting something out, so one letter leaves the word champion

parts.note: P is the physics abbreviation for power

explanation.surface: A fresh sports winner sweating strength sports a shaggy haircut.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exuding' removes P from CHAMPION, and 'new' rearranges the remaining CHAMION.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the hairstyle with a central strip of upright hair and shaved sides, named after the Native American people.

clue.text: See man leaving northern city

indicators.note: leaving means going away, so the word man drops out

parts.note: Manchester is a city in northern England

explanation.surface: Watch a fellow depart a city in the north of England.
explanation.walkthrough: 'See' looks like a verb, but it is a bishop's diocese; 'northern city' is not the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Crossword sense: a see is a bishop's diocese, and Chester is a cathedral diocese.

clue.text: Get across place and 'ang about

parts.note: to place something is to put it
hang about means hover; the apostrophe shows the H dropped, Cockney style, leaving 'over

explanation.surface: An instruction to position something and loiter, spoken in a Cockney accent.
explanation.walkthrough: The dropped H in ''ang' tells you to drop the H of the synonym too.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: to get an idea across is to communicate it successfully.

clue.text: Having broached French wine, wobbling a bit or shaking

indicators.note: broaching a cask means piercing it, so the wine is opened and letters go inside

parts.note: vin is French for wine

indicators.note: wobbling suggests unsteady movement, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: After opening some French wine, someone sways a little or trembles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wobbling' and 'shaking' both suggest movement, but only 'wobbling' is the anagram signal; 'shaking' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a shaking is a trembling movement, a vibration.

clue.text: English theologian needing external support is most radical

indicators.note: needing external support means the support goes around the other letters

parts.note: a rest is a support, as for a cue or an arm
DD is Doctor of Divinity, a theologian

explanation.surface: An English divine who needs propping up turns out to be the most extreme.
explanation.definitionFit: Political sense: red is the colour of the far left, so the most red is the most radical.

clue.text: One offering advice quietly on street gets into row

indicators.note: gets into means enters, so these letters go inside the row

parts.note: a tier is a row, as of seats
p is piano, the music direction for quietly

explanation.surface: An adviser sneaking down the road gets into an argument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'row' suggests a quarrel; here it is a tier.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a tipster gives advice, especially racing tips to punters.

clue.text: Acting without love, one supposedly very blind and eccentric

indicators.note: without means leaving out, so a letter goes from the synonym

parts.note: acting is doing something
love is zero in tennis, the letter O
from the saying 'blind as a bat'

explanation.surface: An oddball performer, loveless and short-sighted.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang synonym: a dingbat is a crazy or eccentric person.

clue.text: City's defenders sadly lacking iron

definitions.note: read as 'City is', the 's being a link

indicators.note: sadly signals the letters are left in a sorry jumble
lacking means without, so letters drop out of the word defenders

parts.note: Fe is the chemical symbol for iron

explanation.surface: A town's guardians, regrettably, are without weapons.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lacking' removes FE from DEFENDERS; 'sadly' rearranges the remaining DNDERS.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Dresden is a city in eastern Germany, on the Elbe.

clue.text: Call girl, model

parts.note: Vi is a girl's name, short for Violet
to model for an artist is to sit

explanation.surface: A list: an escort and a fashion model.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Call girl' looks like one phrase; split it, as 'Call' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to call on someone is to pay them a visit.

clue.text: Oversentimental state — should keep very quiet

indicators.note: keep means hold inside, so the letters go within the other word

parts.note: to state is to say
pp is pianissimo, very quiet in music

explanation.surface: A soppy state of mind; one ought to keep it hushed.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: sappy describes something mawkish or over-sentimental.

clue.text: Digital devices used by some musicians

definitions.text: Digital devices used by some musicians

parts.words: Digital devices used by some musicians
parts.note: 'digital' here means held in the fingers: guitarists pluck strings with small picks

explanation.walkthrough: 'Digital' suggests electronics, but it means 'of the fingers'.
explanation.definitionFit: Plural of the small pick a guitarist or mandolinist holds between finger and thumb.

clue.text: Label attached to cat

parts.note: a tab is a small label or tag
by means close beside, as in 'stand by me'

explanation.surface: A name tag is fixed to a pet cat.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a tabby is a cat with a striped or mottled coat.

clue.text: The male politician offering ropy stuff

parts.note: he is the male pronoun
MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A male MP offering something of dubious quality.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ropy' suggests poor quality in British slang; here it means used for rope.
explanation.definitionFit: Material: the plant fibre is twisted into rope.

clue.text: Looking to escape from the match? …

definitions.text: Looking to escape from the match? …

parts.words: Looking to escape from the match?
parts.note: the match is a marriage; a couple who have split live apart

explanation.walkthrough: 'match' suggests sport, but here it is a marriage, as the following clue confirms.
explanation.definitionFit: A couple living apart after a marital breakdown, short of divorce, have escaped their match.

clue.text: … unlike this person, enjoying it?

parts.note: continues the last clue: the woman on her wedding day is happy with the match

explanation.walkthrough: Read with the previous clue: the newly married woman enjoys the match.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman on her wedding day is presumably delighted with the marriage she is entering.

clue.text: Shock reported for at least 48 hours

indicators.note: reported means spoken, so a word with the same sound is wanted

parts.note: to shock someone is to daze them

explanation.surface: A shock announced to last for two days or more.
explanation.definitionFit: Plural count: forty-eight hours make two full spans of twenty-four hours.

clue.text: Nan's dry bap, disgusting thing to eat

indicators.note: disgusting describes a mess, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Grandma's stale bread roll is revolting food. A bap is a British soft bread roll.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a brandy snap is a crisp rolled ginger biscuit, often cream-filled.
